item.title: Find the right ferry queue
item.summary: An announcement helps foot passengers find the correct queue.
item.transcript_text: The ferry to West Bay leaves at half past nine. If you have a bicycle, wait by the blue gate. If you are walking, use the small door next to the ticket window. Please have your ticket ready. You can buy water on the boat, but there is no shop at West Bay.

questions.prompt: What does the message help people do?
questions.explanation: The speaker tells travellers how and when to board.

questions.prompt: Who should wait by the blue gate?
questions.explanation: The blue gate is for people who have bicycles.

questions.prompt: Where should people on foot go?
options: To the door by the ticket window
To the end of the blue gate
questions.explanation: The small door by the ticket window is for people on foot.

options: At a shop in West Bay
questions.explanation: The speaker says you can buy water on the boat.
